title: Link Building
seo: Ethical link building for online stores
meta: Relevant links from other sites, earned in an honest way with no paid link schemes. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Link building done carefully and honestly
overview: We look for real chances to be mentioned by sites your customers already read. That means suppliers and partners who can list you, local and industry directories, useful resource pages, guest articles and broken links that your content could replace. Every contact is personal and relevant. We do not buy links, run link swaps or use private blog networks, because those can cause penalties. You receive a record of each link target, message and outcome.

faq: Can you promise a number of links?
No. Real links depend on other site owners saying yes. We promise careful, personal outreach and a clear record of every message, not a fixed result.
Do you buy links or swap them?
No. Paid links and link swaps break search engine rules and can harm your store. We only pursue links that a human editor chooses to give you.
Will you send emails from my address?
Only at the Premium level, and only with your approval of the messages. We use your business email, and we follow anti-spam rules with real, personal messages.
How soon will I see an effect on search?
Links take time to be found and to influence search. We do not claim quick ranking changes. We report what we earned, and you can watch your visits in analytics.
